comparison.objective: Carry a hot drink to a tray, moving no faster than 10 cm/s over a designated zone.
comparison.physical_skill: Stable transport with speed and spill-risk control, not bimanual mandrel-and-hammer manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Mug reaches the tray while respecting the 10 cm/s zone limit; candidate instead requires fracture, containment, and component integrity.
comparison.reason: Tests constrained transport rather than insert tang removal.
